scope: Laguna S 2.1 Q4_K_M raw-Q6 dense/shared WMMA prefill tile on gfx1151

repo.qualification: Candidate measurements were made in the implementation worktree; clean selector-unset production publication remains required.

candidate.resident_layout: unchanged raw GGUF Q6_K; no sidecar or transpose
candidate.arithmetic: unchanged Q6 decode, FP16 WMMA operands, FP32 K accumulation order, and BF16 stores

actual_weight_leaf.scope: nine counter-rotated burst-three HIP-event samples for all six supported tiles on actual model weights

validation.red: The focused default-policy test failed collection because _default_q6_tiles did not exist.
validation.green: The default/rollback policy test passes; both aligned/boundary Q6 CPU-reference fixtures are BF16-byte identical between 16x32 and 64x16.
validation.affected_bundle: tests/test_gguf_q4_k_wmma_prefill.py, tests/test_gfx1151_backend.py, tests/test_gguf_linear_dispatch.py, tests/test_laguna_gguf_runner.py, and tests/test_laguna_moe_gpu.py all pass with two expected skips.

full_model.scope: one resident owner; matrix512/attention128; one 128-row warmup per mode; seven counterbalanced synchronized pp512 repetitions

trace.scope: cached aligned and boundary CPU-reference fixtures under rocprofv3
trace.command: HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-q6-dense-wmma16x32-trace --output-file q6-dense --log-level error -- .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_gguf_q4_k_wmma_prefill.py::test_gguf_q6_k_wmma_prefill_matches_cpu_reference

decision.action: Promote 16x32 as the raw-Q6 dense/shared WMMA candidate default and retain the 64x16 environment override through clean selector-unset publication.
